pharmacology.text: STS-135 acts a potent cannabinoid receptor agonist in vitro, with an EC50 of 51 nM for human CB2 receptors, and 13 nM for human CB1 receptors.

uses.text: STS-135 (N-(adamantan-1-yl)-1-(5-fluoropentyl)-1H-indole-3-carboxamide, also called 5F-APICA and ACBM-2201) is a designer drug offered by online vendors as a cannabimimetic agent.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety and panic, vomiting, confusion, psychosis and seizures, and some have caused deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。其所屬的合成大麻素類藥物可能造成心跳加速、焦慮與恐慌、嘔吐、意識混亂、精神病症狀與癲癇發作，部分已造成死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。其所属的合成大麻素类药物可能造成心跳加速、焦虑与恐慌、呕吐、意识混乱、精神病症状与癫痫发作，部分已造成死亡。

fact.en: Its other name, 5F-APICA, points to its bulky adamantane group, the same cage-shaped hydrocarbon found in the medicines amantadine and memantine.
fact.zh: 它的另一個名稱5F-APICA，指出它帶有龐大的金剛烷基，這種籠狀的碳氫結構也出現在藥物金剛烷胺與美金剛中。
fact.zhHans: 它的另一个名称5F-APICA，指出它带有庞大的金刚烷基，这种笼状的碳氢结构也出现在药物金刚烷胺与美金刚中。
